recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast graphic composition featuring four distinct human silhouettes in dynamic, star-jump poses, each rendered in a flat primary color against a solid black background, framed by bold, industrial sans-serif typography at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Rhythmic repetition of human figures in 'X' poses
Primary color sequence (Blue, Yellow, Red, Green) against deep black
Symmetrical framing between top and bottom text blocks
coreInvariants: Four distinct silhouettes in primary colors

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures centered horizontally in the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central red and yellow figures provide the strongest focal point due to color warmth.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye moves from the top text, down through the sequence of figures from left to right, to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space separates the text from the central imagery, creating a stark, clean look.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation for figures; low value for background; high value for text.

letterConstructionRules: Squarish proportions with slightly rounded outer corners
characterSpecificRedesigns: Open 'R' with a diagonal leg starting from the vertical stem

typesetting.lineBreakPattern: Single word or short phrase per line

composition.scale: Large, spanning nearly the full width

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in two different positions for symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, industrial, 80s tech aesthetic perfectly.
Similar squarish geometry and wide stance.
Captures the geometric, wide-set feel but with sharper corners.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid black canvas. In the center, place four flat-color human silhouettes in a row. From left to right: a woman in a dress (Blue), a man in a jacket (Yellow), a person in a long coat (Red), and a man in a t-shirt (Green). All should be in an 'X' star-jump pose with arms and legs spread.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in a light grey, extra-bold, wide-set sans-serif font. One line at the very top and one line at the very bottom, both centered and spanning approximately 90% of the width.

verificationChecks: Are the silhouettes flat colors with no shading?
Is the font wide-set and extra-bold?
Are the figures in the correct color order: Blue, Yellow, Red, Green?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific band logos
Do not use trademarked character silhouettes
Do not replicate exact facial features in silhouettes

mustAchieve: High contrast between black and colors
Clean, sharp edges on all graphics

postGenerationChecks: Check for color bleed between silhouettes
Verify that the grey text is legible against the black
Confirm the 'X' pose is distinct for all four figures
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid background + row of flat-color silhouettes + wide-set framing typography = Retro-Electronic Aesthetic.
